dialog.english: ��������What's that sound?!
It sounded like a gear.
It wasn't a flying saucer, was it?
dialog.translation: No será un platillo volador, no?

dialog.english:
Whatever it is, it doesn't give me
a good feeling.
dialog.translation: Sea lo que sea... no me gusta.

dialog.english:
Yeah. Well, standing here talking 
about it won't get us anywhere. 
Should we try following it?
dialog.translation:
Ya... Bueno, quedarnos aquí
charlando no nos lleva a ningún
lado. Lo seguimos?

dialog.english:
Instead of worrying about that, we
should look for clues to see if
there are any other humans here.
dialog.translation:
En vez de preocuparnos por eso,
deberíamos buscar pistas de si hay
otros seres humanos aquí.

dialog.english: Hey, Sora!
What is it, Piyomon?

I feel better since we're 
traveling together, Sora! I want
to learn all I can about you!
dialog.translation:
Me siento mejor desde que viajamos
juntas, Sora! Quiero aprender todo
sobre ti!

dialog.english:
You're just going out and saying
that outright...
dialog.translation:
Y simplemente lo piensas y lo
dices, así sin más.

dialog.english: Piyomon's a real friendly Digimon.
Hey, Sora! Let's hold hands!
dialog.translation: Eh Sora! Vayamos de la mano!

dialog.english:
(Can I really get along with a
clingy Digimon like her?)
dialog.translation:
(Podré llevarme bien con un
Digimon tan pegajoso?)

dialog.english: The road!

Sora! I don't care how much sand
there is, I'll follow you wherever
you go!
dialog.translation:
Sora! No me importa cuánta arena
haya. Te seguiré vayas a dónde
vayas!

dialog.english: Wait! Piyomon!

We keep walking and walking, but I
can't see anything.
dialog.translation:
Seguimos andando y andando, pero
no consigo ver nada.

dialog.english:
Considering all the telephone
poles we're seeing, surely there 
must be humans around somewhere.
dialog.translation:
Viendo la cantidad de postes
telefónicos que hay, seguro que
debe haber algún humano por aquí.

dialog.english:
Wait a second! I'll try using my
pocket telescope.
dialog.translation:
Para un segundo! Usaré mi catalejo
de bolsillo.

dialog.english:
Aaaaargh! Where in the world are
we?!
Huh...? Ah? Ah! There's a village!
dialog.translation: Eh...? Ah? Ah! Hay un pueblo ahí!

dialog.english:
And if there's a village, that
means there have to be humans!
dialog.translation:
Y si hay un pueblo, eso significa
que habrá personas!

dialog.english:
All right! Let's head for that
village!
Okay!
...And it was a Yokomon village.
Yokomon! Yokomon are my friends!

Let's ask them if they've seen any
other humans around here.
dialog.translation:
Preguntémosles si han visto otros
humanos por aquí.

dialog.english: What kind of Digimon are you?
Huh? Me?!

This is a creature called a
"human".
A "human"? Not a Digimon?

Seems like they haven't seen other
humans before.
dialog.translation:
Parece que no habían visto humanos
antes...

dialog.english: How did you evolve, Piyomon?

After I met Sora, I was suddenly
able to evolve.
dialog.translation:
Al conocer a Sora, de repente pude
evolucionar.

dialog.english:
So you can only evolve when a
human's around?
dialog.translation:
Así que sólo puedes si hay
un humano cerca?

dialog.english:
It must be because I want to
protect Sora!
dialog.translation:
Debe ser por que deseo
proteger a Sora!

dialog.english:
Protect me? But she's so clingy!
Does she *really* think she can do
that?
dialog.translation:
Protegerme? Pero si eres muy
dependiente!
(De verdad que piensa eso?)

dialog.english:
We'll treat you to a feast later,
so please look forward to it!
dialog.translation:
Habrá un festín luego, así que
no os lo perdáis!

dialog.english:
Humans are really big. I'd like to
let you rest in my house, but you
won't fit.
dialog.translation:
Los humanos son enormes. Os
ofrecería mi hogar, pero no
cabríais dentro.

dialog.english:
You sound different now, Piyomon.
Are you talking like a human?
dialog.translation:
Suenas diferente, Piyomon.
Hablas ahora como los humanos?

dialog.english:
Are you the only ones in this
village?
dialog.translation:
Estáis sólos vosotros en este
pueblo?

dialog.english:
It's just us. But there's a
Digimon called Meramon who lives
on Montaña Panorámica.
dialog.translation:
Sólo nosotros. Pero un Digimon
llamado Meramon vive en la
Montaña Panorámica.

dialog.english: Meramon... Montaña Panorámica...

Come to think of it, I saw
something falling towards Outlook
Mountain earlier.
dialog.translation:
Ahora que lo pienso, antes vi algo
caer hacia la Montaña Panorámica.

dialog.english: We saw a black gear a while ago!
dialog.translation: Vimos una rueda negra hace poco!

dialog.english:
Maybe that black gear's around
here.
dialog.translation:
Quizás la rueda negra esté por
aquí.

dialog.english: Did it fly in this direction?
Yeah.

Either way, my throat is really,
really dry.
dialog.translation:
Sea como sea, tengo la garganta
muy seca.

dialog.english:
There's a well here! The water
comes from Montaña Panorámica, so
it's delicious!
dialog.translation:
Hay un pozo aquí! El agua viene de
la Montaña Panorámica y es
deliciosa!

dialog.english: W-we're saved!
But the well's dried up.

It's empty now, but it had water
up until yesterday...
dialog.translation:
Está vacío ahora, pero tenía
agua hasta ayer...

dialog.english: I'm buuuuuurniiiiiiiiing!
What was that?!

It's coming from Montaña Panorámica!
Lemme use my telescope.
dialog.translation:
Viene de la Montaña Panorámica.
Usaré el catalejo.

dialog.english: I'm burning...I'm...
I'm burning up right nooooow!

It's Meramon! He's screaming and
running this way!
dialog.translation:
Es Meramon! Viene gritando y
corriendo hacia aquí!

dialog.english: This isn't how Meramon usually is!

If he gets here, he'll burn down
the village!
dialog.translation: Si viene, quemará toda la aldea!

dialog.english:
Everyone, let's get out of here
now!
But where do we run?!

There's a boat in the lake! We
could do some hidin' in there.
dialog.translation:
Hay un bote en el lago. Podríamos
escondernos allí!

dialog.english: All right, everyone, let's go!

Wait! It looks like some of the
Yokomon are missing!
We have to help them escape!
Thanks, Sora! I'll help you!

There's still Yokomon in the
village! Sora, we have to hurry up
and help them!
dialog.translation:
Aún quedan Yokomon en el pueblo!
Sora, tenemos que ayudarles,
rápido!

dialog.english: Right! I'm coming!

We've evacuated the Yokomon
village. Piyomon?
dialog.translation:
Hemos evacuado el pueblo Yokomon.
Piyomon?

dialog.english: Come this way!
Piyomon! You came to save me!
We're friends, aren't we?

You idiot...
trying to help others at the last
minute...
dialog.translation:
Idiota...
Intentar ayudar a otros en el
último minuto...

dialog.english: Sora! What's wrong? Come back!
Piyomoooooon!

Sora? Did you come here to save
me?

Of course I did! You're my friend
and you're important to me!
dialog.translation:
Claro que sí! Eres mi amiga y eres
importante para mí!

dialog.english: Thank you, Sora!
This time, I'll protect you!
We have to help Piyomon too!
Fuego Mágico!
Llama Bebé!
MiniFuego!
Keheheheheheh...

Meramon is absorbing all of the
attacks! They won't work on him!
dialog.translation:
Meramon absorbe todos sus ataques!
No funcionan contra él!

dialog.english: I'm burning up!
Piyomon!

Sora... Sora's in danger...
I can't just give up!
dialog.translation:
Sora... está en peligro.
No puedo rendirme!

dialog.english: Piyomon evolved!

It's because I promised to protect
you, Sora.
Thank you!
Uuuughhhhhh!

We won with the power of
Birdramon's fire!
dialog.translation:
Ganamos gracias al fuego
de Birdramon!

dialog.english: That's...the black gear!

That black gear was in Meramon's
body! That's why...
dialog.translation:
La rueda negra estaba en Meramon!
Esa es la razón...

dialog.english: Sora! Sora!
Piyomon! Thank you so much!

It was only natural! It's because
I love you, Sora!
dialog.translation:
Era lo natural, por que te quiero,
Sora!

dialog.english: Why was I...?
Meramon! You're back to normal!

A black gear fell from the sky...
after that...I don't know...
dialog.translation:
Una rueda negra cayó del cielo. No
recuerdo nada más...

dialog.english: You don't remember, Meramon?

Meramon! Please keep protecting
Montaña Panorámica like you did
before!
dialog.translation:
Meramon! Sigue protegiendo la
Montaña Panorámica como antes!

dialog.english: Like I did before...?

Looks like the Yokomon really
like you, since you've stopped
being a bad Digimon.
dialog.translation:
Parece que los Yokomon te aprecian
mucho, especialmente con buena
actitud.

dialog.english:
Is that so? Then I'll return to
Montaña Panorámica.
dialog.translation:
Ah si? Volveré a la Montaña
Panorámica.

dialog.english:
Everyone! The Yokomon said
they'll give us food as thanks!
dialog.translation:
Chicos! Los Yokomon dicen que nos
darán comida!

dialog.english: Yay!
Piyomon saved me...

She actually evolved because I was
in danger.
dialog.translation:
Digievolucionó por que estaba en
peligro.

dialog.english:
All right! Please hurry and escape
that way!
dialog.translation:
Vale! Daos prisa y escapaz por
ahí!

dialog.english: You saved me!

You're scared, aren't you? Come
on, and get out of here as soon as
you can!
dialog.translation:
Tienes miedo, no? Vamos, salgamos
de aquí rápidamente!

dialog.english: Okay! Thank you!
Sora! We found one!
Hurry up and get out of here!
dialog.translation: Daos prisa e idos de aquí!

dialog.english: Got it! I'll hurry!
Sora! This little one's injured!

I'm okay! I can still move! Go and
help my friends!
dialog.translation:
Estoy bien! Me puedo mover! Ayudad
a mis amigos!

dialog.english: Got it!
Get away before Meramon comes!
I, I'm scared...

It'll be all right! Sora and I
will pull through somehow!
dialog.translation:
Todo irá bien! Sora y yo lo
conseguiremos como sea!

dialog.english: Really?

Yeah, so you have to escape as
soon as you can!
dialog.translation:
Si, escapa lo más pronto que
puedas!

dialog.english: T-thank you...
Why are you hiding over here?

I thought it'd be safe if I hid
here.
But *we* found you here...

Y-yeah, you did! I guess this
place isn't safe after all.
dialog.translation:
Hm.. si! No parece ser tan seguro
después de todo.

dialog.english: All right, go find the others now!
dialog.translation: Vale, busca a los demás ahora!

dialog.english: This little one's sleeping.
Fwaaah! H-huh? Where's everyone?
Why is it in a place like this?
We were playing hide-and-seek...

Meramon's gone wild and he's
coming this way! Hurry and go join
the others!
dialog.translation:
Meramon se ha vuelto loco y viene
hacia aquí. Apura y ve con
los demás.

dialog.english: O-okay!

Sora! We have to get out of here,
now!
Mimi! Calm down!
Scold her harshly
Speak to her calmly

If you don't pull yourself
together, you're going to make
things worse for the rest of us!
dialog.translation:
Si no te comportas, lo harás todo
mucho más difícil para todos!

dialog.english:
That's easy for you to say, but
I'm scared! I can't help it!
dialog.translation:
Muy fácil para ti decirlo, pero
no puedo evitar tener miedo!

dialog.english: Mimi...

We still have some time before the
fire gets here, so just stay calm.
Everything's gonna be okay.
dialog.translation:
Aún tenemos algo de tiempo hasta
que llegue el fuego, ten calma.
Todo saldrá bien.

dialog.english:
Y-yeah...Yeah, it'll be all right.
Thank you, Sora.
dialog.translation:
S..Sí, todo saldrá bien.
Gracias, Sora

dialog.english:
T.K! Hurry up and get out of
the village!
dialog.translation: T.K! Apura y sal ya del poblado!

dialog.english: I wanna help everyone, too!
Scold him harshly
Speak to him calmly

T.K, you're the youngest, so
you should go on ahead!
dialog.translation:
T.K, eres el más joven, deberías
ir delante!

dialog.english:
So I'm in the way because I'm a
kid.
dialog.translation:
Así que estorbo por que soy un
niño.

dialog.english: That's not what I meant...

T.K, you need to escape the
village. I'm counting on you to 
lead the Yokomon out of here.
dialog.translation:
T.K, debes escapar del pueblo.
Cuento contigo para evacuar a los
Yokomon.

dialog.english:
Got it! I'll be waiting outside
the village!

Is that all of them? There might
be some who haven't escaped yet!
dialog.translation:
Estos eran todos? Quizás aún
quede alguien rezagado!
